statements.t: We are targeting the fourth quarter of 2026 for transition of the remaining services, subject to completion of the necessary operational and contractual steps.
The transition is intended to improve operational independence, accountability and our ability to support future growth.

We intend to maintain discipline in the pace and terms of capital deployment, and there can be no assurance that evaluated opportunities will result in definitive agreements or completed transactions.

This policy takes into account our long-term growth objectives, including our anticipated investments for organic growth, potential acquisitions and stockholders' desire for capital appreciation of their holdings.
No cash dividends have been paid to the Company's stockholders since January 30, 1989, and none are expected to be paid for the foreseeable future.
We continue to evaluate the valuation technique we will apply to the Skyline Note in future periods.

estimates.name: Fair Value of the Skyline Note
estimates.t: Determining whether such events have occurred, and whether they would result in a change in fair value, requires significant management judgment given the limited financial and market information available for an early-stage company.
